action: No security action is needed; Microsoft says this was not an attack. Microsoft 365 customers: confirm that delayed email has arrived, check for service credits under your agreement and review how staff communicate when email is down.
exec: A prolonged email and collaboration outage shows dependence on one cloud supplier; Microsoft says it was not an attack.
impact: Outlook, Teams and Copilot were disrupted in 74 countries; per CyberCube the broader incident lasted about 38 hours.
plain: A fault in Microsoft's email servers on November 12 took down Outlook and slowed Teams, Copilot and other services around the world, with recovery running into November 14. Microsoft says a network upgrade caused it, not an attack.
summary: Outlook, Teams and Copilot were disrupted from 12 November in 74 countries, per Al Jazeera. Microsoft says a technical issue from a network capacity upgrade caused it, not malicious activity (via Beinsure); CyberCube puts the broader incident at about 38 hours. Microsoft's interim account, via Mynavi, cites a gateway software defect, with over 80% of gateway servers unresponsive at worst. Acrisure estimates insured losses could reach $700 mn; other estimates are lower.
title: Microsoft 365 outage knocks out Outlook, Teams and Copilot in 74 countries

validation.note: Al Jazeera and Yahoo Finance agree on dates, scope, cause statement and no-cyberattack statement. BleepingComputer returned 403. The earlier 130,000 Downdetector figure could not be confirmed and was removed.
